title: Tennessee Valley Authority 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: TVA filed a Form 8-K on April 13, 2026 disclosing that President and CEO Donald A. Moul entered into a separation and release agreement on April 7, 2026. The severance and retirement benefits are materially consistent with TVA's existing Executive Severance Plan and Long-Term Incentive Plan. This is a routine corporate governance announcement with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
